correctness.rationale: For the classical complex genus-two Kummer quartic, each of 16 smooth trope conics passes through 6 of 16 nodes; two different conics meet at two designated nodes. The six tangent directions at each A1 point lie distinctly on a nonsingular projective conic. Evaluation of homogeneous jets on the six P1 points has ranks 1,3,5,6 in degrees 0,1,2,3, yielding local normalization length delta=5+3+1=9 (not planar 15); independently D is Cartier since six local Z/2 classes sum to zero and 2D~16H, D²=256, K_K=0, so p_a=1+256/2=129. This adjunction route verifies the key global conclusion independent of local-jet filtration subtleties.
